# tenant-quota

> Per-tenant usage quotas over UTC calendar windows: plan limits with overrides, atomic check-and-consume through a store port, reservations, soft-limit events and reset times Python package `trysac-tenant-quota`, import name `tenant_quota`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
